description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript plugin source files to identify import boundary violations involving bundled plugin files, web search registry issues, and related inventory policies. It includes functions for collecting, comparing, and displaying inventory data, and runs checks as a script.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares inventory entries based on file, line, kind, specifier, and reason to establish order.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for a resolved extension path based on its pattern and kind.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an inventory entry to the provided entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a source file for import boundary violations related to bundled plugin paths.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects potential registry policy issues in web search plugin files.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be excluded from inventory processing based on its path.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory data on plugin extension import boundaries, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the expected inventory JSON from the baseline file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes differences between expected and actual inventory entries.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string summarizing boundary violations.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry as a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the inventory collection and comparison check, outputting the results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script; executes the boundary check process.
